company.name: CyberPulse
company.mission: Produce the most accurate, evidence-based picture of cyber security, AI security and AI-related developments, with an Australia-first perspective and global coverage.

agents.title: CEO
agents.summary: Chief executive and chief editor: sets the day's priorities and signs off the daily report.

agents.title: Operation
agents.summary: Watchdog and SRE: triages incidents and reviews code changes.

agents.title: Collector
agents.summary: Wakes the worker's collection, the source gate and ground truth over HTTP; runs no model.

agents.title: Researcher
agents.summary: Research, context and developing events for the desk digest.

agents.title: Publisher
agents.summary: Editorial check: samples what was published and says what does not hold up.

agents.title: Finder
agents.summary: Source discovery: proposes new sources from the worker's finds.

agents.title: Cheap
agents.summary: Cost ceiling and model scout: reads the scan and the gauntlet and proposes cheaper models.

agents.title: Coder
agents.summary: Collectors, parsers and the platform: fixes what TELETRAAN files.

routines.name: Daily editorial
routines.summary: Overnight digest, follow-ups, gaps, VOIGHT verdicts and the daily report.

routines.name: Desk digest
routines.summary: Review the candidate events in the desk digest: Australia first, then global, then AI.

routines.name: Daily QA sample
routines.summary: QA a sample of yesterday's published events.

routines.name: Follow-up
routines.summary: Work the follow-up queue and report on each task due.

routines.name: Source discovery
routines.summary: Read the worker's discovery finds and propose sources, plus any open gap topics.

routines.name: Model scan
routines.summary: Read the daily model scan and report what changed.

routines.name: Model gauntlet
routines.summary: Report the weekly gauntlet results and raise each new proposal.

routines.name: Monthly cost review
routines.summary: Reconcile last month's spend and report to MORPHEUS.
